alt: 雨中的公車站，一名孩子把傘移向淋濕的同伴；連在他頭上的回憶小景裡，他自己也曾沒有傘、淋雨發抖。
scene_prompt: At a rainy bus stop, a schoolchild carrying an open umbrella notices another same-age child soaked and shivering without one. The first child shifts their umbrella to shelter the other as well. Above the generous child's head, one clearly attached soft-edged memory bubble shows that SAME child previously standing in rain without an umbrella, wet and cold; keep the hairstyle and clothing identical. The bubble tail originates unambiguously at the helping child's head. The remembered personal discomfort leads directly to considerate help now. Only one memory bubble, no text.
